A distraught daughter has asked you to free her father's trapped soul from the clutches of a dark spirit. 

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}

===Objectives===
* Defeat the [[Lady of the Dead]] and free the soul of [[Sinni]]'s father.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Venture south of Sinni's village to find the [[Ancient Remains (Zehlon Reach)|Ancient Remains]]. Activate the altar to summon the [[Lady of the Dead]], and defeat her to complete the quest. Low-level parties should spread out when fighting, as the Lady is a [[dervish]] and can deal a lot of [[AoE]] damage with her attacks.

==NPCs==
===Foes===
[[Djinn]]
*{{d}} 15 (25) [[Lady of the Dead]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Sinni
:''"My father was a fool and his fate is fitting, but I am still his daughter. I have long hoped to spare his spirit the torment he earned in life. I had entombed him in an altar as is our way. Unfortunately, a dark spirit trapped his soul. There is now only one way to free my father’s soul. Someone must journey to my father’s altar and defeat the dark spirit binding it. Are you noble enough to risk your life aiding the spirit of a foolish man?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I’ll do what I can.
| decline = I have enough things to worry about.
| ask = My father’s soul waits, bound to his altar. Free him.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Sinni
:''"Thank you, hero. My father always said, "Life is pain. Anyone who tells you different is selling something." I am beginning to believe him. Take this please, it is not much but I am thankful."''

==Trivia==
* The quote "Life is pain. Anyone who tells you different is selling something." is likely taken from the movie [[w:The Princess Bride (film)|The Princess Bride]].
